_comment: Example native QwenPaw cron-job payloads (POST /api/cron/jobs). Verified against /app/src/qwenpaw/app/crons/models.py (CronJobSpec, JobsFile v2). The server generates the job id — do not send one. Replace TARGET_USER_ID and TARGET_SESSION_ID with real values from GET /api/cron/dispatch-targets while logged into the console. Send while logged in (these endpoints return 401 without auth).

request.input: Give me a short daily summary: unread urgent email, calendar for the next 2 hours, and any stuck todos. Keep it under 10 lines.
Check the inbox for anything urgent that arrived in the last 30 minutes. Only report if something needs my attention; otherwise stay silent.
